name: nl-reading
description: Read Dutch with tap-to-look-up dictionary, de/het and verb help, audio, translations and SRS flashcards. A PWA hosted on Cloudflare Workers.

scripts.build: npm run build:content && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.build:cf: (git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository | grep -q true && git fetch --unshallow --quiet); npm run data && npm run build
